nl_statement: Let f be a real uniformly continuous function on the bounded set E in $R^{1}$. Prove that f is bounded on E.
nl_proof: Since $E$ is bounded in $\mathbb{R}$, it is totally bounded. A uniformly continuous function maps totally bounded sets to totally bounded sets. In $\mathbb{R}$, totally bounded sets are bounded, so $f(E)$ is bounded.
